characters.name: Manddatteren
characters.prompt: A kind and diligent young woman with a Scandinavian appearance, wearing simple traditional Norwegian attire. She has a gentle and determined expression, with long blonde hair, ready to help everyone she meets on her journey.

characters.name: Kjærringdatteren
characters.prompt: A lazy and entitled young woman with a Scandinavian appearance, dressed in slightly shabby clothes. She has an arrogant expression and a posture that reflects her disdain and laziness.

characters.name: Troldkjærringen
characters.prompt: An old and wicked troll-woman with a mischievous grin, dressed in old, tattered clothes, her eyes gleaming with cunning intentions. Her posture is hunched, and she carries an aura of magical malevolence.

characters.name: The Cow
characters.prompt: A large and beautiful cow with a full and round udder. It carries a milk pail on its horns and has a gentle, pleading expression, standing on a lush, green meadow with bright white and brown patches.

characters.name: The Goat
characters.prompt: A large goat with thick, luscious wool dragging along the ground. A pair of big, twisted horns adorn its head with a pair of playful eyes. It stands in the meadow with a peaceful demeanor, ready to lend its wool.

characters.name: The Apple Tree
characters.prompt: A majestic apple tree with branches bending under the weight of ripe, red apples. The tree stands strong on a green field; its trunk sturdy, with a humble demeanor, despite the sweet temptation it bears.
